name: Night Thrasher

abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.True Accuracy: Bu saldırılar Otomatik Blok ve Kaçış (Evade) etkilerini yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Disorient: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu ve blok yeterliliğini belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Debilitate: Debilitate dışında yeni uygulanan debuff'ların süresini uzatır.
abilityDetails.Taunt: Saldırı gücünü %40 azaltır ve özel saldırı etkinleştirme şansını %70 artırır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

signatureAbility:
Board To Death
The final hit of Night Thrasher's Heavy Attack has a 35% chance per active Gadget Debuff to inflict a Taunt Debuff for 10 seconds.
Striking a Taunted opponent with Skateboard Attacks grants a permanent Fury Buff, increasing Attack by [997.3 - 1994.56]. Max 10 stacks. When Knocked Down these Buffs are lost.
After being Knocked Down Night Thrasher has a [25 - 50]% chance to Purify all Debuffs.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Night Thrasher's advanced combat suit grants him immunity to Incinerate effects and [750] Physical Resistance.
Night Thrasher gains +[144.74] Critical Damage Rating for each Unique Debuff on his opponent. This ability is not affected by Ability Accuracy Reduction.
Well Timed Blocks and successful Dodges grant 5% of max Power while Night Thrasher is under 1 Bar of Power.

abilitySections.title: Skateboard Attacks
content: Champions of the Contest never see the skateboard coming. Attacks using the skateboard have passive True Accuracy.

abilitySections.title: On Opponent Knockdown
content: Refresh the duration of all active Gadget Debuffs and Purify 1 Debuff on Night Thrasher.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: All Gadget Debuffs are paused during Night Thrasher's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Night Thrasher uses the Shock Baton to inflict Shock dealing [3,989.2] Energy Damage over 12 seconds.

If this attack is activated after striking with a Light Attack, Night Thrasher instead uses the Smoke Capsule Gadget, inflicting Disorient. Disorient reduces Enemy Defensive Ability Accuracy by 50% and lowers the opponent's Block Proficiency by 50% for 15 seconds.

If this attack is activated after striking with a Medium Attack, Night Thrasher instead uses the Explosive Gadget to inflict a [3,989.2] Incinerate Debuff for 15 seconds. This Debuff's damage updates with changes to Attack Rating.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, gain a +[916.67] Precision Buff for 18 seconds. For each Unique Debuff effect on the opponent, base potency is increased by another +[916.67].

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict a Passive Debilitate, extending the duration of all Debuffs by 75% for 45 seconds.
